title: TXU Gas Rate Hike Public Hearing
summary:
*   A public hearing was held to gather community input on a proposed rate increase by TXU Gas Distribution Company.
*   The council officially closed the public hearing regarding the potential gas rate adjustments.
*   This special meeting was exceptionally brief, lasting only one minute and focusing solely on the gas utility rate discussion.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
THURSDAY, AUGUST 2, 2001
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting. While the minutes are not in sequential order, all agenda
items were discussed.
The City Council of Austin, Texas, convened in a regular meeting on Thursday, August 2,
2001 in the Board Room at Lower Colorado River Authority Hancock Building, 3700 Lake
Austin Boulevard.
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.
1. 
Conduct a public hearing regarding proposed rate increase by TXU Gas Distribution
Company.
The public hearing was closed on Council Member Griffith's motion, Mayor Pro Tern
Goodman's second by a 5-0 vote. Council Member Wynn was off the dais.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 6:01 p.m. was approved on Council Member
Griffith's motion, Mayor Pro Tern Goodman's second by a 5-0 vote. Council Member
Thomas was absent. Council Member Wynn was off the dais.
The amended minutes for the regular meeting of July 19, 2001, Special Called
Meetings of August 2, August 6, and August 9, 2001 and the minutes for regular
meeting of August 9, 2001 were approved.
